newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch money market rates ease slightly, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Dutch money market rates ease slightly, trade thin.

text.p: Dutch money market rates eased slightly in quiet trade on Wednesday, with market players focusing on the outcome of the Amsterdam summit next week.
Call money was quoted between 3.00/06 and 3.00/12 bid/ask, down some six basis points from Tuesday.
Trade focused on call money and short term deposits, dealers said. They said activity would remain thin as long as EMU uncertainty lasted.
"At the moment, EMU still seems quite far away," one dealer said.
No primary activity in Dutch Treasury Certificates (DTCs) was noted.
DTCs maturing in July were set at an indicative price of 3.13 percent, those maturing in August at 3.14 percent and December DTCs at 3.18 percent.
The guilder was virtually unchanged from Tuesday's level, trading at 112.521 per 100 marks, up from 112.495.
